title: Lug wrench with the unclosed tally

body:
Keep the pesticide trial jars sealed until the boundary check is done. The neighbor keeps knocking because the map says don't go; the dog is still in the yard.

We kept one copy for ourselves. The person collecting the other one said the numbers would be corrected later, once everyone had moved.

I do not know which of the two accounts was repeated afterward. The older one is the one I had in my hands that day.
title: The jars stay sealed
